title: Updated guidance on NDAs in workplace sexual harassment matters
summary: The VLSB+C has updated its guidance on NDAs in workplace sexual harassment matters after a new Victorian Act commenced on 1 July 2026. It warns that lawyers who breach the Act's requirements could face disciplinary action.
what_changes: Under the Act, an NDA is enforceable only if the complainant initiates it and is not influenced or pressured into signing.
The complainant must receive a mandatory information statement and a 21-day review period in which to get legal advice.
Each party must confirm on an approved form that the preconditions were met.
The regulator states that lawyers who draft, negotiate or advise on NDAs must be familiar with the Act.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian lawyers who draft, negotiate or advise on NDAs in workplace sexual harassment matters.

history.event: VLSB+C updated its NDA guidance after the Victorian Act restricting NDAs commenced on 1 July 2026.
